ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Flowplan uses the camera when you take a photo for a page or a whiteboard, or scan a document.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Flowplan uses the microphone when you record a voice note or a video for a page.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Flowplan opens your photos when you choose pictures to add to a page.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Flowplan saves images to your photos when you ask it to.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Flowplan uses Face ID to unlock the app when the app lock is on, and to confirm approvals of workflows.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Flowplan turns your voice notes into text on this device.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Flowplan connects to your Flowplan instance when it runs in your local network.

android.restriction_server_description: Address suggested on first start, e.g. https://flowplan.example.com
